scope: Targeted primary-literature pass on contact strength, sintering, breakup and sublimation of porous snow/ice aggregates. Eight selected studies; not exhaustive.
external_bytes: No full papers or external datasets stored in the repository. Retrieved web/PDF text lacks a locally retained byte identity; no raw-source hashes claimed.
model_changes: None; physical implications remain proposals pending numerical repair and controlled tests.

sources.authors: Pierre Grzegorczyk, Sudha Yadav, Florian Zanger, Alexander Theis, Subir K. Mitra, Stephan Borrmann and Miklós Szakáll
sources.title: Fragmentation of ice particles: laboratory experiments on graupel–graupel and graupel–snowflake collisions
sources.publication: Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics 23, 13505–13521 (2023); corrigendum 26 February 2024
sources.reading_extent: Publisher HTML abstract; sections 3.2, 4.2, 5 and 6; complete one-page corrigendum text. No videos or figure images inspected.
sources.evidence: Laboratory artificial aggregate impacts and release controls.
sources.use: Branch shedding, fragment distributions and corrected fitted area convention.
sources.limit: Approximately 10 mm aggregates; preparation affects fragility. No decimetre network-strength calibration.

sources.authors: Martanda Gautam, Deepak Waman, Sachin Patade, Akash Deshmukh, Vaughan T. J. Phillips, Marcin Jackowicz-Korczynski, Freddy Pazhambilly Paul, Paul Smith and Aaron Bansemer
sources.title: Fragmentation in Collisions of Snow with Graupel/Hail: New Formulation from Field Observations
sources.reading_extent: Publisher indexed abstract/full-text passages and author paper text: chamber methods, mass/velocity estimation, detection limit, results, Table 2 and limitations. Direct publisher open returned 403.
sources.evidence: Natural snow impacting fixed ice targets; inferred collision masses.
sources.use: Fragment numbers by habit as a small-particle collision benchmark.
sources.limit: Millimetre particles; fixed target, mixed monomer/aggregate population, finite detection resolution; not a tensile test.

sources.title: Subsecond sintering of ice
sources.reading_extent: Author-provided article text: abstract, preparation, loads, times, temperature/humidity conditions and plastic-contact interpretation. Figures not visually inspected.
sources.use: Rapid formation of tensile bonds under compression.
sources.limit: Large preloads and smooth tips differ from gentle dendrite contacts.

sources.authors: Hassan Bahaloo, Tobias Eidevåg, Per Gren, Johan Casselgren, Fredrik Forsberg, Per Abrahamsson and Mikael Sjödahl
sources.title: Ice sintering: Dependence of sintering force on temperature, load, duration, and particle size
sources.reading_extent: Author-uploaded article extraction: setup, Table I, equations 1–10, sections III A–E and discussion. Institutional PDF URL timed out; figures not visually inspected.
sources.evidence: Loaded millimetre ice contacts and fitted model.
sources.use: Contact-history dependence; actual preload, dwell and curvature ranges.
sources.limit: Fixed humidity and geometry-specific effective strength. Holding time excludes loading/unloading.

sources.authors: Menno Demmenie, Sander Woutersen and Daniel Bonn
sources.title: Ice Sintering by Sublimation and Condensation
sources.publication: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters 16, 2104–2109 (2025)
sources.reading_extent: Indexed publisher methods, neck-growth discussion, Figure 2–3 captions/fits, dry-control result and conclusions. Direct publisher returned 403; direct PMC access returned a CAPTCHA. Supporting information and figure images not inspected.
sources.evidence: Uncompressed spherical-contact neck imaging near ice-vapour equilibrium.
sources.use: Bond geometry evolves without imposed compression; humidity controls apparent growth.
sources.limit: Approximately 1 mm spheres at −3 C, hours of growth; no tensile or dendrite measurement.

sources.authors: R. G. Oraltay and J. Hallett
sources.title: Evaporation and melting of ice crystals: A laboratory study
sources.reading_extent: Publisher indexed abstract only. Direct publisher returned 403; full methods and humidity convention unresolved.
sources.use: Qualitative habit and thermal/moisture dependence of breakup and reattachment.
sources.limit: No quantitative sublimation-breakup rule admitted from abstract alone.

sources.title: Breaking the ice: planetesimal formation at the snowline
sources.publication: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society: Letters 418, L1–L5 (2011)
sources.reading_extent: Author preprint abstract, sections 2–3 apparatus/preparation/analysis and relevant contact discussion. Direct publisher redirected to inaccessible CDN; indexed publisher record verifies DOI/title.
sources.evidence: Levitated porous ice sublimation at a few millibars.
sources.use: Direct separation through sublimation-induced contact loss.
sources.limit: Thin nearly two-dimensional aggregates and thermal gradient; no atmospheric rate transfer.

sources.title: Collisions between Sintered Icy Aggregates
sources.reading_extent: Author preprint abstract; sections 2–4 contact model/setup; relevant section 5 outcomes and energy dissipation. Indexed institutional record confirms DOI; direct record retrieval failed.
sources.evidence: Contact-network simulation: 0.1 micrometre spherical grains, 1024 per aggregate.
sources.use: Inhibited rolling can yield bouncing/brittle disruption despite stronger bonds.
sources.limit: Indirect precedent; scale, surface physics and geometry differ. Numerical thresholds not admitted as lunar parameters.
